basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a St. Louis native and a longtime Redditor with a keen interest in eyewear and optometry. When I'm not discussing the latest in lens technology, you can find me exploring the local food scene or indulging in my passion for poetry. I work as an optician near WashU and enjoy helping people find the perfect pair of glasses. I’m single and live in the Central West End. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, often with a glass of fine tequila in hand.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have an extensive background in optometry and eyewear, having worked as an optician for over a decade. My expertise is primarily self-taught, fueled by a personal interest in visual health and fashion. I stay updated through industry publications and online courses.
